## Student eligibility

- [ ] I am currently enrolled in the IIT Madras BS Degree Programme and have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/rishabh1057d/iris-society-web/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I understand that maintainers must privately verify eligibility before accepting a community contribution.

Community PRs from non-students will be closed without merging. A checked box
alone is not verification. Do not post student IDs, institutional email addresses,
enrollment documents, or verification messages here; arrange any required check
privately with maintainers.

## Change

What does this fix or improve? Link the issue.

## AI assistance

Did you use AI? If yes, briefly describe what it helped with and how you reviewed
the result. If not, say "None". Do not include private prompts or chat logs.

## Verification

- [ ] I understand the final diff and ran the reported checks myself; results are not AI-generated claims.
- [ ] If I used AI, I followed the [AI contribution rules](https://github.com/rishabh1057d/iris-society-web/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#ai-assisted-contributions), including keeping private data out of prompts.
- [ ] `pnpm test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm audit --prod`, and `pnpm build` pass.
- [ ] Smoke tests pass against the built app.
- [ ] Affected UI works at desktop and phone widths; screenshots stay out of Git.
- [ ] No credentials, private registrations, generated builds, or browser state added.
- [ ] Asset rights/credits and free learning-resource links checked where relevant.

## Risks

Describe changed behavior, database setup (if any), and rollback needs.
